title: Hands Up
style: rap, hyperpop, gritty electronic, processed vocals, vocal, metal, bassline, fake, gradual, strong, rapid, rhythmic, electronica, hands up, minimal, low, clean
lyrics:
[Intro]
[whispered vocals]
Hands up
Wanna quit then?

[Verse 1]
You think you're done, you're pullin' back
White flag up, that's not your track
I saw you move, I saw you try
But fear got cold inside your eye
Hands up high, don't drop 'em now
Say what you came, don't act like "wow"
You wanna quit? Then quit right
Show me that fire, show me grit

[Pre-Drop]
Quit then
Quit then

[Drop]
HANDS UP!
Wanna quit then?
HANDS UP!
Wanna quit then?
[Verse 2]
You had the spark, you had the flame
Now you're talkin' 'bout givin' in, same
I don't follow weak declared
Stand up strong or get out aired
No white flags, no surrender
This ain't time for you to end her
End it, finish, close the door
Fight it out, show what you bore

[Pre-Drop 2]
Quit then
Quit then
Harder now
Harder now

[Drop 2]
HANDS UP!
Wanna quit then?
HANDS UP!
Wanna quit then?
NOT TODAY!
Quit then?
NOT TODAY!
Quit then?
